sentence_stem: Although we have sent several reminders,
correct_completion: we have not yet received your payment.
full_sentence: Although we have sent several reminders, we have not yet received your payment.
acceptable_variants: we still have not received your reply.

options.text: so we have cancelled your order.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, and cancelling the order is a result, so the sentence becomes illogical.

options.text: we will send another reminder next week.
options.why_wrong: This is a future action and does not contrast with the reminders already sent.

options.text: we have not yet received your payment.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, which clashes with the contrast expected after 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part. Turkish speakers may be tempted to use a cause connector here because Turkish marks concession differently, so the English contrast needs to be kept clear.
translation: Birkaç hatırlatma göndermemize rağmen, ödemenizi henüz almadık.
